user.title: Connect to WhatsApp Bridge
user.description: Enter the WebSocket URL of the WhatsApp Bridge.

scan.title: Scan QR Code
scan.description:
Setup is almost complete!

Click **Submit** to finish adding the integration.

After you submit, check your **Notifications** (bell icon) for the QR code to link your WhatsApp account.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the bridge. Make sure the Node.js service is running.
error.not_ready: WhatsApp is not ready yet. Please ensure you have scanned the QR code.
error.initializing: WhatsApp client is initializing. Please try again in a few seconds.
error.no_qr_received: No QR code received. If you are already logged in, check the logs.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Please check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: WhatsApp notifications

add_target.title: Add notification target
add_target.description: Enter a name and one destination. This creates a notify entity for that chat.

data_description.name: Shown on the notify entity, for example Family.
data_description.number: Country code plus number, without +. Leave empty when using a group.
data_description.group: Exact WhatsApp group name. Leave empty when using a number or group ID.
data_description.group_id: Stable group ID from get_groups. Leave empty when using a number or group name.

remove_target.title: Remove notification target
remove_target.description: The notify entity for this chat will be removed.

error.name_exists: A notification target with this name already exists.
error.invalid_number: Enter the phone number with country code, without +.
error.missing_destination: Enter a phone number, a group name, or a group ID.
error.multiple_destinations: Enter only one destination: phone number, group name, or group ID.
